title: THE SKY MODEL: every Cutis tier is Soft Sky's body (two stalks, a 4.5 s cycle, the gait's stride, the membrane at .65, the walk at 1 radius a second), in its own colour, with slight ladders of size (0.6 to 1.2) and urgency (1.3 to 2.5)
context: Owner, 2026-10-30: "what is different in the stats and behavior and rendering of Cutis Soft Sky; it looks and feels the best of all. we should model all other Cutis on the 03, while keeping separate colors and slight variations in aggressivity and sizes." What was different, measured from src/content/pearl-enemies.js: Sky (blue, the terminal's 03) was the only tier that still moved and read as the kit draws it. Its body hopped on two seeking stalks at a 4.5 s cycle (the set's own row), the walk capped at 1 radius a second at x1.08 (PEARL_PACE), its membrane at .65 with the skin's own colour and white glints (PEARL_MEMBRANE), no pearl, scale 0.8. Every other tier had been pulled away from that by earlier rounds: the ivories and lemons were gliding blobs with no stalks (2026-10-16), 0.4 and 0.6 the size at 5 and 2.8 radii a second (the ivory with a 3.6-radius stride); the hard cores had longer cycles (5 / 4.5 / 4 s), three stalks (brown, black), caps of 0.7 / 0.6 / 0.5, the transfer's power 2.5, and membranes of .26 (orange, green), 1.35 with the pearl drawn over and a depth twin (purple, brown) and .4 (black); the aggression ran .35 to 4. Hit points and the heart's bite differ by tier too (PEARL_PACE hp .6 / .7 / .85 / 1.8, heart .1) but are the difficulty, not the body.
decision: Model every tier on Sky and keep the colours, the pearls and two slight ladders. src/content/pearl-enemies.js: ROWS every tier seekCount 2, cycleDuration 4.5; aggression 1.3, 1.5, 1.6, 1.7, 1.9, 2.1, 2.3, 2.5 (the ladder still grows); PEARL_TIERS transferAcceleration 1.8 and reach 11 for all; PEARL_MEMBRANE every opacity .65, the cored tiers' tint pull and tinted glints kept as their colours (black's red glints by enemyspec's dark-body rule), `pearl` (the pearl drawn over a full skin) retired with the gain; PEARL_BODY.scale 0.6, 0.7, 0.75, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2 in the set's own order (orange under blue, as tiers.ts sizes them); PEARL_PACE every tier x1.08, no glide, no own stride, no reach, hp and heart kept, the walk cap 1 radius a second for the soft tiers and 0.9 for the cored (the audit's margin, below). Nothing in src/fx changed: creature-pearl draws every tier as it drew Sky.
outcome: 1) The audit's margin: at 1 radius a second for all eight, test/pearl-motion.mjs's follow audit stepped the onyx 15.01 radii a second once in 1,715 frames and the amethyst 15.24 (the pop is 15; Sky passes at 1 by its margin), so the cored tiers walk at 0.9, a tenth under Sky. 2) The soft hunt audit (test/pearl-motion.mjs) failed first with 34 and 29 pops a tier on the ring. Traced, not patched: a body's hop pace is set once at its spawn from the record's speed (src/fx/creature-pearl.js add), and the test spawned its bodies at the blobs' 5 m/s, which fixed a 1.6 m hopper's cycle at 0.68 s for life, so every catch-up on the ring hurried it past the pop. With the record's real walk at spawn (as src/fx/creature-bodies.js lookInto spawns it) no variant pops, the owner's ring knobs included (orbit 0.25, the jab 3.5 m over 1.6 s): worst 8.45 / 8.21 radii a second, HUNT_CAP re-based to 9 / 9 (were 10 / 12 over the blobs' 9.3 / 11.2). The ring is read from 45 to 60 s and the hull drives off at 60 (a hopper 8 cells out reaches the ring in ~35 s at 2.3 m/s hunting, not ~10). A reported-walk fix in src/fx/soft-hunt.js and slower ring knobs were tried on the way and reverted: with the spawn speed right they change nothing. 3) test/hull-bodies.mjs measures the soft body's shove at its farthest, not at the end: a hopper hops back onto its record once the hull is past. 4) test/pearl-enemies.mjs pins the model: every tier Sky's four kit values, the two ladders in range and growing, every membrane .65, no pearlShow, every cored pool's pearls under its skin at the kit's order with no depth twin; the bestiary keeps its own .45 for purple and brown (BESTIARY_STAGE.skin) over its black stage. 5) The dead `reach` knob found and retired: PEARL_PACE's reach 1.35 for the hard cores (2026-10-16, "longer appendages") never reached a body, src/fx/creature-pearl.js sets the gait's stride after it. 6) The dead knob `hop` (the ivory's long stride) retired with the glide. Not changed: hit points and heart damage by tier, the squads, the capacities, the ram and the absorb, the soft hunt's ring, SOFT_HUNT.pace (white 1.35, yellow 1.25 over the capped walk). 7) The browser steps, both stale on the base since the glide: --bestiary green again (its white stalk check was the glide's: a blob has no stalk to stretch; its entry count read '04 / 11', the hostiles alone, since THE WHOLE TERMINAL's 49). --pearl-story green in full for the first time since the glide (the base fails its motion audit: the gliding whites 2,442 re-placements, 0 hops), after two readings of its ram check were corrected: the soft check read the window's LEAST frame-to-frame speed after the ram, which the headless frame-time jitter after a ram takes to 10-14 m/s while the mean stays 29-30 against 28.5 before (probed frame by frame: 14 to 45 m/s alternating), so it reads the mean now; and the cored check, a drifter stopping the hull, is tried on another lane when the hit was glancing (the orange body at 0.75 is 2.2 m, the hull's half width, and a hop aside before the hull came halved its speed, 29.8 -> 14.5, where the head-on runs stop it at 0.0), as the step already retries a walk-off. On the green run: the whites 49 hops of 2.67 s at p95 4.7 radii a second, 0 pops; the hull through an amoeba 32.1 -> mean 30.4 m/s, the amoeba dead; into a drifter 28.7 -> 0.0, overlap at most 0.02 m; 166 bodies, 332 stalks, 0 in the rock.
alternatives: Sky's membrane exactly (no tint pull, white glints) for the cored tiers too: the cored read of 2026-10-18 showed a cored body at the tank's distance reading as a glossy white one with a pale pearl in it; the pull and the tinted glints are the separate colours the owner asked to keep, so they stay.
Hit points and the heart's bite at Sky's .85 and 1 for all: a difficulty change, not the body; left to the owner (one line each in PEARL_PACE).
Keep the gliding blobs for the ivories and lemons: the owner's 2026-10-16 "for now"; the Sky model is the hop on stalks for all eight.
Every tier at 1 radius a second: two cored tiers popped in the audit at the margin; 0.9 for the cored is the slight variation the audit asked for.
Slow the ring's circling and jab for hoppers and report the ring's step as the record's walk (tried, reverted): the pops were the test's spawn speed, not the ring's.
evidence: npm test green (test/pearl-enemies.mjs, test/pearl-motion.mjs, test/hull-bodies.mjs rewritten where they pinned the old table), npm run check, npm run architecture green.

The hunt sim swept in the scratchpad (12 bodies, 70 s): with the blobs' spawn speed 34 / 29 pops a tier at the owner's knobs and 22 to 41 under every slower ring tried; with the record's real spawn speed 0 pops at every knob, worst 8.2 to 9.2 radii a second.

--pearl-story PASS (SECTOR 2: the sector's own waves as Pearl bodies, 95 whites at r0 1.3, the motion audit 0 pops every tier, stalks and footprints 0 in the rock, the ram and the cored stop, the slow's ice, a phantom's cloak); artifacts/browser/pearl-story.png.
The base (the Sky model stashed): --pearl-story fails at its motion audit (white: frames 0, hops 0, replaced 2,442), so the ram check had no baseline there.
